gloss: to decay; to rot; to crumble

definitions.gloss: to decay; to rot; to crumble away
definitions.explanation: For something (typically wood, buildings, or organic matter) to deteriorate over time and fall apart. Often carries a literary or evocative tone. Can also be used figuratively for reputations or names fading into obscurity.

examples.english: The old tree is rotting away.

examples.japanese: ⟦{廃墟|はいきょ}→廃墟：12453_haikyo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{柱|はしら}→柱：05009_hashira⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧{朽|く}ちかけて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The pillars of the ruins are already beginning to crumble.

examples.japanese: ⟦{名|な}→名：03496_na⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧{朽|く}ちていった⟦{無数|むすう}→無数：00300_musuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{兵士|へいし}→兵士：11680_heishi⟧たち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れて→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ならない→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: We must not forget the countless soldiers who perished in obscurity.

notes: An ichidan verb with a somewhat literary or elevated register. Common collocations: ⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{朽|く}ちる (wood decays), ⟦{骨|ほね}→骨：02166_hone⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{朽|く}ちる (bones crumble away), ⟦{名|な}→名：03496_na⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{朽|く}ちる (a name fades into obscurity). The compound {朽|く}ち⟦{果|は}てる→果てる：28565_hateru⟧ means 'to rot away completely.' Contrasts with the more everyday ⟦{腐|くさ}る→腐る：02049_kusaru⟧, which focuses on biological decomposition with unpleasant qualities (smell, slime), while {朽|く}ちる suggests gradual deterioration over a long period.
